name: framefields-vision
description: On-device computer vision in framefields — object detection and tracking, instance segmentation, pose, person mattes and cutouts (RTMDet-Ins, RTMO, Selfie Segmenter), soft alpha matting of hair and motion blur (ViTMatte), and prompted video tracking of a specific object or several people with SAM 2.1 Tiny or Small (point/box prompts) and SAM 3 (text prompts such as "man in white shirt", multiple objects at once). Covers which API to use (withVision, comp.vision, analyzeVisionSequence), every pin
author: gatewai-dev
